name: Ramses CL V2
not_assessed: shared control: the score says no key is shared, but this contract's own independent read lists another tracked contract with the same admin (unresolved, 12/10: do not read "no key shared" as established)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A real DEX with $6.3M TVL, governed through a Timelock whose delay is deliberately set to zero - arguably worse than no timelock at all.
narrative.detail: Governed through a centralized AccessHub rather than per-contract Ownable. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by both "RamsesTimelock" and an address labeled "Ramses Team Multisig" - traced one hop further rather than trusting the label: that "multisig" is a Safe with exactly one owner and threshold 1, the sole signer a bare EOA. RamsesTimelock.getMinDelay() returns 0 - a real, deployed timelock-shaped contract with none of the substance. Batch 8 pinned down RamsesTimelock’s exact address (previously undistinguished from AccessHub) and found PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE are all held by that same single "Team Multisig" address - a timelock in name only, on every axis, not just its delay.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
